message: hermes compile: the built-in Go network archive is built for the host and cannot be linked into an artifact cross-compiled to V_target. Build a g* c-archive for V_target and pass it with --link-static, or compile this unit natively.
why: A Go c-archive is host-architecture machine code. Cross-compiling the unit to another target while linking the host-built archive produces either unresolved hermes_net_* symbols or an architecture mismatch — and the linker's complaint names a symbol, not the real cause.
fix: build the g* c-archive for V_target (GOOS/GOARCH matching the target) and pass it with --link-static
or drop --target and compile this unit on the host it will run on
